answers.explanation: Training let the organization take the hit and keep working. That's robustness.
A parallel copy replaced the failing part on the fly.
Fast detection and a written plan mean fast recovery.
Prioritizing resources toward the critical function is resourcefulness.
Multiple providers are a classic redundancy measure.
Patching kept the system working under attack.
Mobilizing external expertise is resourcefulness. (Cross-training would have helped too.)
Recovery time is the rapidity metric.
Multiple suppliers, for example, are redundancy and also help rapidity. The Rs overlap; the drill asks for the best fit.
